question: Using only the data from the ‘results’ table, find the three years in which the sum of the highest total points earned by any driver and the highest total points earned by any constructor in that year (both calculated by summing up points from the ‘results’ table) is smallest, and list those three years in order of ascending total.
sql:
WITH yearly_driver_points AS (
  SELECT r.year, rd.driver_id, SUM(rd.points) AS driver_total
  FROM results rd
  JOIN races r ON rd.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, rd.driver_id
),
yearly_constructor_points AS (
  SELECT r.year, rd.constructor_id, SUM(rd.points) AS constructor_total
  FROM results rd
  JOIN races r ON rd.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, rd.constructor_id
),
max_driver_by_year AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(driver_total) AS max_driver_points
  FROM yearly_driver_points
  GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor_by_year AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(constructor_total) AS max_constructor_points
  FROM yearly_constructor_points
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  md.year
FROM max_driver_by_year md
JOIN max_constructor_by_year mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY (md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points) ASC
LIMIT 3
